newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek money rates hold, FRNs tick up, ecu/drs firm.
newsitem.headline: Greek money rates hold, FRNs tick up, ecu/drs firm.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were trading narrowly in early dealings holding Monday afternoon levels, floating rate notes were a touch higher and ecu/drachma was firmer, dealers said.
"It is very quiet so far," a dealer at a foreign bank said. "Depos and forex swaps are holding with the yield curve flat."
Bond dealers said trading activity was subdued with FRN prices ticking up in early dealings.
Ecu/drachma nudged higher in early trade trading around 307.45/50 on some ecu buying for drachmas by local players, dealers said.
"There was some ecu buying for drachmas from local banks on behalf of their clients that drove ecu/drachma higher," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 157.21/31 from Monday's 157.120 fix, the dollar at 272.02/12 drachmas from 270.700 and the ecu at 307.48/58 from 307.100 drachmas.
